items.summary: A Romanian alien admitted to conspiring with an American citizen to enter into a sham marriage so that she could obtain U.S. citizenship. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted the investigation.

items.title: Haitian Alien Pleads Guilty to Illegally Voting in 2024 Election
items.summary: A Haitian alien pleaded guilty Sept. 22 in federal court to falsely claiming U.S. citizenship to register to vote and casting a ballot in the 2024 general election.

items.title: Man Charged with Naturalization Fraud; Three Others Face Denaturalization
items.summary: A federal grand jury in Charlotte returned a criminal indictment charging Sha Bahadur Ghaley, 42, a naturalized citizen from Bhutan, with naturalization fraud.

items.title: Chinese Aliens Indicted on Naturalization and Firearms Charges
items.summary: Two Chinese aliens turned themselves in Sept. 17 on charges that accuse one of a naturalization crime and both of a firearm crime. The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Missouri made the announcement.

items.title: Bosnian Prisoner Abuser Charged with Lying to Get US Citizenship
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided vital assistance to an investigation that lead to the indictment of Miran Kostic, an alien and accused war criminal from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
